problems: Program began July 2008 (first residents 2008), so the 2011-12 window starts mid-stream; 2011-12 PGYs inferred (unlabelled list). 2012-13 reconstructed. Hanna and Oh both appear in 2017-18 without having been on the 2016-17 roster (Feb 2017 capture) -> transfers in. Davies added mid-2019-20 (between 2019-12 and 2020-05). Complement: 1/yr through the 2018 entry class (occasional 2 via transfers), 2/yr from 2019 except 2020 and 2022 (1). Common Crawl 2012-2013 done (CC-MAIN-2012, 2013-20, 2013-48), no failures. PHASE 2: no program-page roster for 2012-13 exists anywhere; Davies (UNM PGY-1 2018-19) is missing from program 97's reconstructed 2018-19 roster -- flag for the UNM file.
